data.name: Fadhiil
data.gender_notes: Fadhiil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Fadhiil is derived from the Arabic root 'Fadhala' which means 'to honor' or 'to be excellent'. It is a name that evokes a sense of nobility and prestige, reminding us of the importance of striving for excellence and honor in all aspects of our lives. The name Fadhiil carries the meaning “Excellence, Honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fadhiil usually hope their child will grow to embody excellence, honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a beacon of righteousness and honor in the community.
data.etymology: Fadhiil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Excellence, Honor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fadhiil total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فضيل
in_arabic.meaning: ذو فضل، فضل والا، برتری والے
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاعل ہے جو 'ف ض ل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا معنی ہے 'فضل والا' یا 'برتری والا'۔ قرآن مجید میں اس کا ذکر مختلف آیات میں آیا ہے، جیسے کہ 'وَيَضُمُّ فَضْلَهُ' (النساء: 113)۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم کے مطابق اچھی صفات اور اوصاف کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: فضیل
in_urdu.meaning: فضل والا، برتری والا، اچھے کام کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فضیل نام کا مطلب ہے 'جو لوگوں کے ساتھ حسن سلوک کرتا ہے' یا 'جو اپنے کام میں برتری حاصل کرتا ہے'۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کی جڑیں 'ف ض ل' میں ہیں، جس کا مطلب ہے 'فضل' یا 'برتری'۔ اسلامی دنیا میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کو دیا جاتا ہے جو اپنے اچھے کاموں اور حسن کردار کے لئے পরিচিত ہوتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ज़ील
in_hindi.meaning: उत्तम गुणों वाला, श्रेष्ठता प्राप्त करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ज़ील नाम का अर्थ है 'जिसके पास उत्कृष्ट गुण हैं' या 'जो श्रेष्ठता प्राप्त करता है'। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसकी जड़ें 'फ़ द ल' में हैं, जिसका अर्थ है 'फ़ज़ल' या 'श्रेष्ठता'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों को दिया जाता है जो अपने अच्छे कार्यों और अच्छे चरित्र के लिए जाने जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: فضیل
in_pashto.meaning: د فضل لرونکی، د برتری حامل
in_pashto.long_meaning: فضیل نوم د 'ف ض ل' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې 'فضل لرونکی' یا 'برتری حامل' دی. دا نوم د پښتو کلتور او د افغانستان د تاریخي شخسیتونو سره تړلی دی، چې د اسلامي تقويم سره سم د سترګو پرانیستې او ښې ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Fadhiil
in_english.meaning: One who possesses virtues, excellence, and superiority
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fadhiil originates from the Arabic root 'f-ḍ-l', which means 'virtue', 'excellence', or 'superiority'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person with noble qualities, moral excellence, and good deeds. It is mentioned in various Quranic verses, emphasizing the importance of virtues and good character. The name Fadhiil is widely used across Muslim cultures, symbolizing a person's commitment to righteousness and moral integrity.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hadid (d. 1252 CE), in his 'Sharh Nahj al-Balagha' (Commentary on the eloquent statements of Imam Ali), mentioned Fadhl ibn al-Abbas as one of the companions of Imam Ali who possessed immense knowledge and virtues.

Ibn Kathir (d. 1373 CE), in his 'Al-Bidaya wa'l-Nihaya' (The Beginning and the End), described Fadhl ibn al-Qais as one of the generals of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the Battle of Hunain in 630 CE.
